comments.text:
2:34 So, let me explain, Cory:

In April 2021, the game was updated, bringing week 7. After that, the base game was forgotten and only survived thanks to mods created by the community. 

But on April 30, 2024, the game was finally updated, bringing Weekend 1 (which many still say is week 8, but IT IS NOT), where we play as Pico (the character from week 3). This update also included 12 songs called Er3cts Remixes, which are remixes of the original songs. 

In June 2024, the game was updated and came with a mini-update called "Pit Stop 1: Rankings". This update brought 2 new Er3cts Remixes and a results screen with different animations, ranging from L (Loss), G (Good), E (Excellent), and P (Perfect). 

In September 2024, the game received another update called "Playable Character," which allowed players to play as Pico and brought 12 new remixes, new result animations, new stages, and a new menu featuring Lotus Juice (one of the composers of the Persona games). 

In April of this year, the game was updated again with the arrival of "Pit Stop 2: Song Pack," bringing 6 new remixes and new cutscenes and animations.

And finally, in July of this year, the game finally had an official mobile version. Week 8 will likely be released next year.

NEO??? OH MY GOD. I haven't seen that mod in so long! I was actually pretty in with the whole development cycle, and was on a streamed podcast with the creator (goes by blaise now, not Jellyfish), very cool guy, the whole team save for a very (very) select few are great people and they make excellent music! The current development team for the newest version as of right now I have little to no association with at the moment, which is unfortunate but honestly NEOs memory is one I like to keep positive, the newest version just isn't it. 

Also for the old fans out there, NBC, LilyPichu, PIGEOT... far too many to name  honestly. I miss y'all, you guys are real ass people and those livestreams and voice calls were some of the most positive times I ever had in the FNF community. You guys rule. 

Thanks for bringing this video back Cory, this made my day!
- JALEDM

Corryyyy!!! Friday night funkin has updated and got a major update, if you you into the freeplay section you will see so much new things. That guy pico with the orange hair and green shirt from week 3 got his own version of every song, he also got his own week called "weekend 1" 

First thing first is if you wanna know, pico is boyfriends ex, (if you don't know the lore), pico originated from a game called picos school with his friend nene and darnell. The main storyline is daddy dearest (the father of girlfriend) hired pico to murder boyfriend, but instead of doing that pico sang with boyfriend and helped him in week 8 against tankman (the guy in that army)

Next thing you should know is that boyfriend, girlfriend and pico have been considered a trio dispite pico disliking a girlfriend a little for being with boyfriend. 

Next is pico got all of boyfriends songs but remixed, they are called the pico mix, as well as new songs from weekend 1, to unlock pico as a playable character you will have to go to story mode and finish the new week called weekend 1, then you will have to go to freeplay and click on boyfriend to reveal the place where you pick your character, in there you will find very cool music to go with picos playable character, the girl that will be on the boombox will be nene, she wears a pink fit to go with a knife, pico and nene are NOT together, and pico and darnell was enemies for a bit due to pico not killing boyfriend when he was supposed to.

Anyways the last thing i got to say is i really hope you play the friday night funkin update next video and i can't wait to see you lose your minds over the songs they got for you. 




Oh yeah last last thing the pico update is a cannon update. But theres also a non cannon mod that has skid and pump, (the skeleton and pumpkin from week 2) its just like the pico update but its you know. All about them.

The spooky kids originated from an animator named sr pelo (i think). With their monster they brought to the over world named molac. If you wanna check that mod out maybe i heavily suggest you do.
